caseNameFull: Ross v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. L. A. Luce for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key, Bernard Chertco'ff, andBobert L. Stern for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion to defer consideration of the application for writ of certiorari is denied. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit is denied.
